# (velocity/BanMessage) reads them. Each side has a test that reads this file,

# on a live network, where the only symptom is that nobody gets refused at the
#   payload  kind  uuid  name  when  expires  actor  reason
# "-" means the column does not apply to that kind, "<empty>" an empty string.
